caption: Four analog samples, the four levels of a 2-bit uniform quantizer, and the code stored for each. Sample 0.1 lies nearer level 0 than level 0.33, so it is stored as code 0.

spec.title: Sampling and 2-bit quantization
spec.aria: Four analog samples 0.1, 0.4, 0.7 and 0.9 are mapped to levels 0, 0.33, 0.67 and 1.00 and stored as 2-bit codes 0, 1, 2 and 3.
